the integrative dimension is a new dimension in the process evaluation of organization performance and that it is a new dimension which is based on the MCDA-C methodology and which is used to evaluate the performance of the subsystems in the organization.

the incorporation of the organizational subsystems inter-relations and their impact upon the performance of the organization as a whole.
the development of an evaluation model for organization performance which is based on the MCDA-C and which incorporates the integrative dimension.
the identification of the variables which contribute most to the system performance, as well as the identification of those strategies which are the most adequate to improve performance.

the use of the integrative perspective in the process of organizational performance evaluation is an innovative and effective way of improving the performance of the whole system, thus allowing for a better understanding of the inter-relationships and inter-connections between the subsystems and the organization as a whole.

the integrative dimension, when incorporated in the performance evaluation process, allows for a more realistic and complete evaluation of the performance of the organization, as a whole, and of each subsystem.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the integrative dimension allows for the identification of the variables that affect the performance of the organization subsystems and the subsystems that affect the performance in which they are involved.
the integrative dimension is the result of the combination of the subsystem performance evaluation and the performance evaluation of the system as whole.

the integrative dimension is a way to evaluate the performance of a subsystem in the light of the impact it has on the system as a while, as well as the impact the other subsystems have on its performance.

the integrative dimension is essential in the process of performance evaluation, as the subsystems' performance improvement strategies must be aligned with the system's global performance.

the incorporation of the inter-subsystem relations and the integrative dimension, as a result of the MCDA-C, will allow for the identification of the most adequate strategy for the organization performance improvement.
